description_en: Change the billing method for a Graphic Computing Service instance
description_zh: 变配云渲染资源实例付费类型
kebab_example: aliyun vs modify-rendering-charge-type --rendering-instance-id render-9f8c57355d224ad7beaf95e145f22111 --instance-charge-type PostPaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRenderingChargeType

parameters.help_en:
This value is valid only when `InstanceChargeType` is `PrePaid` (subscription).

Enable or disable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Enable.

false: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
此值仅在 `InstanceChargeType` 为 `PrePaid`（包年包月）时有效。

开启或关闭自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
This value is valid only when `InstanceChargeType` is `PrePaid` (subscription).

The duration for subscription. Valid values (Note: If you select 12, it converts to one year; other values are in months):

1 (default)

2

3

4

5

6

7

8

9

12
parameters.help_zh:
此值仅在 `InstanceChargeType` 为 `PrePaid`（包年包月）时有效。

包年包月的时长。取值范围（注：当选12的时候会被换算为一年，其余以月为周期单位）：

1（默认）
2
3
4
5
6
7
8
9
12
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
This value is valid only when `InstanceChargeType` is `PostPaid` (pay-as-you-go).

Billing type. Valid values:

Hour: Hourly
parameters.help_zh:
此值仅在 `InstanceChargeType` 为 `PostPaid`（按量付费）时有效。

计费类型，取值范围：

Hour：小时
parameters.name: instance_billing_cycle

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Graphic Computing Service instance
parameters.name: rendering_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The target billing method for the instance. Valid values:

PrePaid (default): Subscription.

PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的目标付费方式，取值范围：

PrePaid（默认）：预付费包年包月。
PostPaid：后付费按量付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type
